submission.justification: K3 has the best resolution (2.9% in the 2025 summary) but its intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day is 4x the 0.5 budget, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. Of the remaining crystals, K1 (0.30 counts/kg/day, within budget) has better resolution than K2 (8.5% in the 2025 summary). I simulated K1 at 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 cm. The minimum is at 5 cm with 4.43% FWHM. K2 was not simulated; its 8.5% comes from the 2025 summary at 5 cm.

requirements.evidence: K1 at 5 cm gives 4.43% FWHM, the best of the thicknesses scanned (2-8 cm). It is the best among crystals that meet the background constraint. K3 is better on resolution (2.9%) but fails the background constraint.
K1 intrinsic background is 0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day, below the 0.5 budget. K3 is 2.0 and fails.
